images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 24 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 76 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a charcoal ribbed knit beanie, a cozy fleece full-zip jacket with an all-over blue and navy abstract pattern and a stand collar, a plain white crew-neck t-shirt, relaxed beige wide-leg cotton trousers with small subtle paint splatter marks, a structured brown smooth leather tote bag with two top handles, and a pair of off-white low-top leather sneakers. RIGHT HALF: a headless body-only full-body street style photo of a young Korean man in his 20s wearing exactly the same items (blue patterned fleece zip jacket open over the white t-shirt, beige wide paint-splatter trousers, off-white sneakers, holding the brown leather tote in one hand), walking through a bright airport departure terminal with soft morning light through large windows, only in the lower 76 percent, the image is cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft natural daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no borders.
